meta.name: security-research
meta.description: Team Mode security research skill. Orchestrates 3 vulnerability hunters and 2 PoC engineers to audit a codebase in parallel, prove exploitability, classify root causes, and calibrate severity by actual exploitability. Use for security review, vulnerability research, exploitability audit, pre-release security check, threat model validation, and `/security-research`. Triggers: 'security-research', 'security research', 'security review', 'vulnerability audit', 'exploitability audit', '보안 리뷰', '취약점 감사'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 并行审计代码库，发现漏洞并验证可利用性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要对代码库进行深度安全审查并验证漏洞可利用性
copy.tagline_en: Audit codebases in parallel, find vulnerabilities and verify exploitability
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need deep security review of codebases with exploitability validation

howto.what: 它会以 Team Mode 拉起 5 名成员(3 名漏洞猎手、2 名 PoC 工程师)并行审计代码库,验证漏洞能否真正被利用,按实际可利用性定级,最后给出 PASS、PASS WITH FINDINGS 或 BLOCK 的结论报告。
howto.when: 当你提到“security review”“vulnerability audit”等关键词,或使用 /security-research 时触发;需开启 team mode,并给出仓库、diff、PR 等具体审计目标。

say.text: 对当前仓库做一次安全审计
say.note: 没给目标时,审计当前仓库与当前分支 diff

say.text: 审计这个 PR 的 diff,重点看认证和数据隔离
say.note: 认证、数据隔离由专门的猎手负责

say.text: 验证一下这个漏洞能不能真正利用
say.note: 两名 PoC 工程师会复现或推翻它

howto.what_en: It runs a Team Mode team of 5 (3 vulnerability hunters, 2 PoC engineers) to audit a codebase in parallel, prove exploitability, and return a report with a PASS / PASS WITH FINDINGS / BLOCK verdict.
howto.when_en: Triggers on 'security review', 'vulnerability audit' and similar keywords or /security-research; requires team mode tools and a concrete target such as a repo, diff, or PR.

say_en.text: Run a security audit of this repository
say_en.note: With no target, it audits the current repo and branch diff

say_en.text: Audit this PR diff, focusing on auth and data isolation
say_en.note: Dedicated hunters cover auth and data isolation

say_en.text: Prove whether this finding is actually exploitable
say_en.note: Two PoC engineers reproduce or falsify it
